💡 Quick Tips & Tricks

Small moves that actually stack up. No "just manifest it" energy — real, tested tactics.

$ Quick Win
Flip free stuff on Facebook Marketplace
People literally give away furniture, electronics, and clothes. Clean it up, take decent photos, relist for $20–$80. Zero startup cost.
◆ Underrated
Sell digital products on Gumroad
Notion templates, budgeting spreadsheets, Canva resume packs — make it once, sell it forever. Some creators pull $500+/month from a single $5 template.
⚡ Fast Cash
User testing pays same-day
Sites like UserTesting and Userlytics pay $10–$60 per 20-min test. All you need is a microphone and the ability to speak your thoughts out loud.
★ Smart Move
Use AI to speed-run freelancing
ChatGPT and Claude can help draft proposals, brainstorm gig ideas, and polish your portfolio copy. Don't let them do the work — let them remove the friction.
📌 Pro Tip
Stack multiple small income streams
Don't chase one big payday — combine 3-4 small ones. $200 from flipping + $150 from testing + $100 from templates = $450/month with no single point of failure.
🕐 Mindset
Your first $50 online is the hardest
After that, you've proven it's possible. The psychological shift from "can I?" to "I already did" changes everything. Aim small first, scale later.
